worldcombat.skill.growl.summary: Let out an endearing cry that distracts every foe who can hear it, lowering their Attack. Sound needs no line of sight, so cover does not stop it; the trade is a shallow drop and a short reach.
worldcombat.skill.growl.use.0: Call a ring of close enemies soft when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.growl.use.1: Drop several attackers' output at once while they cluster
worldcombat.skill.growl.use.2: Weaken a threat through cover when it hugs you
worldcombat.skill.growl.description.0: Every enemy who hears loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and carries the 'softened' mark for %2$s; while distracted, companions will not use Growl on an already softened foe again. The Attack drop is a stat stage and does not recover when the mark expires; it lasts until the target leaves combat and its stages reset.
worldcombat.skill.growl.description.1: Cry radius %1$s; every non-friendly inside hears it. Sound ignores line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.growl.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. Centred on you, so anyone outside the ring is untouched.
worldcombat.skill.growl.howl.off: Short cry: quick, small radius, short duration.
worldcombat.skill.growl.howl.on: Long howl: larger radius and longer duration, but slower windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.growl.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When on, stretches the cry into a howl: a much larger radius and longer distraction, but slower windup and cooldown; off keeps it quick and close.
worldcombat.skill.growl.preference.ai.ma: The companion only steps in to cry while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger approaches on its own.
worldcombat.skill.growl.preference.ai.mi: The companion only cries when at least this many non-friendly listeners are inside the radius, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means cry whenever it hears one.
worldcombat.skill.growl.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to cry under a Hold order.
